title: Jesus... I've Restarted The Same Habit Four Times This Month. 🔁
topic: he has restarted the same habit four times this month and day one has started to feel like home

bible.text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've restarted the same habit four times this month.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Gym Monday, gym Tuesday, gone by Thursday. Day one is starting to feel like my home address.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You keep counting the streak. I'm watching the direction.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I keep failing at the same place. What's the point of restarting?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That you restart is the point. Forgetting what's behind includes forgetting the streak that broke. Reach forward, not backward.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Today's count is one. And one is enough for today.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone on their day one again. 🔁
